checks.name: Initial fetch attaches a visible isolated native page; callback loads once and core metadata drops query and fragment
Application dialogs suspend the native page and closing a dialog restores its isolated login
Actual preview has no Node, management bridge or opener; permissions, popups, unbound loopback and core requests are refused
Multiple native tabs share one session; switching sessions destroys old pages and isolates login and local storage
Switching projects preserves each isolated native storage partition and destroys the previous project pages
HttpOnly login and local storage survive full desktop, core and Worker shutdown and restart
Site clear destroys original same-origin pages before clearing cookies and storage and replacing pages
A generation reset after full restart retires the previous process partition ledger and starts empty storage
Port revocation destroys the actual native page without waiting for another user action
